list_child.name: list_dispatch_visits
list_child.desc: Returns every cleaning visit on the crew dispatch schedule, across all clients and states. Use this whenever you need an overview of the visits the service is handling.

decoys.name: list_standing_visits
decoys.desc: Returns every cleaning visit in the recurring standing-order book, across all clients and states. Use this whenever you need an overview of the weekly and biweekly cleans.

decoys.name: list_estimate_visits
decoys.desc: Returns every cleaning visit on the estimate walkthrough calendar, across all clients and states. Use this whenever you need an overview of homes waiting on a price.

decoys.name: list_callback_visits
decoys.desc: Returns every cleaning visit in the reclean callback log, across all clients and states. Use this whenever you need an overview of the jobs clients asked to have redone.

get_child.name: get_visit_ticket
get_child.desc: Returns the job ticket for one cleaning visit identified by its id, including its service type, state, and time. Call this once you already know which specific visit you need.

decoys.name: get_visit_checklist
decoys.desc: Returns the room-by-room checklist for one cleaning visit identified by its id, including each task and its tick mark. Call this once you already know which visit the crew is working.

decoys.name: get_visit_access
decoys.desc: Returns the entry instructions for one cleaning visit identified by its id, including lockbox codes and alarm details. Call this once you already know which home the crew is visiting.

decoys.name: get_visit_timesheet
decoys.desc: Returns the crew timesheet for one cleaning visit identified by its id, including clock-in and clock-out times. Call this once you already know which visit you are paying out.

list_parent.name: list_crm_clients
list_parent.desc: Returns every client account in the cleaning service's CRM, with the contact details on file. This is useful for browsing clients before drilling into a specific account.

decoys.name: list_waitlist_clients
decoys.desc: Returns every client account on the new-service waitlist, with the requested start dates on file. This is useful for filling openings as crews free up.

decoys.name: list_referral_clients
decoys.desc: Returns every client account in the referral rewards program, with the credits earned on file. This is useful for applying discounts before the next invoice run.

decoys.name: list_autopay_clients
decoys.desc: Returns every client account enrolled in card-on-file autopay, with the billing dates on file. This is useful for checking charges before the weekly payment run.

get_parent.name: get_client_card
get_parent.desc: Returns the contact card for one client identified by its id, including the name and email on file. Use this when you need the contact details of a specific client.

decoys.name: get_client_preferences
decoys.desc: Returns the cleaning preferences for one client identified by its id, including products to use and rooms to skip. Use this when briefing a crew on a specific client.

decoys.name: get_client_billing
decoys.desc: Returns the billing history for one client identified by its id, including invoices and payments on file. Use this when answering a question about a client's charges.

decoys.name: get_client_keys
decoys.desc: Returns the key custody log for one client identified by its id, including which crew member holds each key. Use this when tracking down a specific client's house key.

delete_child.name: delete_visit_booking
delete_child.desc: Permanently deletes the booking for a cleaning visit from the schedule, and the deletion is final once it runs. Use this for visits that were entered in error or duplicated by the office.

decoys.name: delete_visit_photos
decoys.desc: Permanently deletes the before-and-after photos of a cleaning visit, and the deletion is final once it runs. Use this when a client asks for pictures of their home to be destroyed.

decoys.name: delete_visit_codes
decoys.desc: Permanently deletes the stored entry codes for a cleaning visit, and the deletion is final once it runs. Use this when a client changes their locks or alarm code.

decoys.name: delete_visit_timesheet
decoys.desc: Permanently deletes the crew timesheet for a cleaning visit, and the deletion is final once it runs. Use this when hours were clocked against the wrong job by mistake.

set_enum.name: set_visit_state
set_enum.desc: Updates a cleaning visit's state to requested, confirmed, completed, or cancelled depending on where it stands. Call this any time the visit's standing changes so the schedule stays accurate.

decoys.name: forecast_visit_state
decoys.desc: Sets the state a cleaning visit is expected to reach by week's end, among requested, confirmed, completed, or cancelled. Call this when planning crew workload so managers can track the week.

decoys.name: request_visit_state
decoys.desc: Submits a request to change a cleaning visit to requested, confirmed, completed, or cancelled, pending office approval. Call this when a crew lead reports a change from the job site.

decoys.name: alert_visit_state
decoys.desc: Sets an email alert that goes out when a cleaning visit reaches requested, confirmed, completed, or cancelled. Call this when a client wants to hear the moment their visit moves along.

set_bool.name: flag_for_qa
set_bool.desc: Marks a cleaning visit as flagged for a quality assurance review by a supervisor. This is used whenever something about the visit warrants a closer look afterward.

decoys.name: flag_pet_home
decoys.desc: Marks a cleaning visit as having a pet in the home, so crews bring lint rollers and keep doors shut. This is used whenever the client mentions a dog or cat on site.
verbs: flag {obj} as having a pet in the home

decoys.name: flag_own_supplies
decoys.desc: Marks a cleaning visit as using supplies provided by the client, so crews leave their kit in the van. This is used whenever the client wants their own products used.

decoys.name: flag_deep_clean
decoys.desc: Marks a cleaning visit as needing a deep clean by the crew, so extra time gets blocked on the schedule. This is used whenever a home has gone a long stretch between visits.

set_ref.name: reassign_client
set_ref.desc: Reassigns a cleaning visit to a different client's account in the system. This is typically needed when a visit was originally logged under the wrong name.

decoys.name: bill_client
decoys.desc: Bills a cleaning visit to a different client's account in the system. This is typically needed when a landlord or relative pays for someone else's clean.

decoys.name: refer_client
decoys.desc: Credits a cleaning visit as a referral to a different client's account in the system. This is typically needed when an existing client sent the booking our way.

decoys.name: gift_client
decoys.desc: Gifts a prepaid cleaning visit to a different client's account in the system. This is typically needed when someone buys a clean as a present for a friend.

send.name: email_client
send.desc: Sends an email notification to a client regarding one of their cleaning visits. This is the standard channel for routine updates about the schedule.

decoys.name: call_client
decoys.desc: Places a phone call to a client regarding one of their cleaning visits. This is the standard channel for urgent questions about access on the day.

decoys.name: invoice_client
decoys.desc: Sends an invoice to a client regarding one of their cleaning visits. This is the standard channel for billing once a clean is finished.

decoys.name: survey_client
decoys.desc: Sends a satisfaction survey to a client regarding one of their cleaning visits. This is the standard channel for gathering ratings after a clean.
child_verbs: send a survey to the client tied to {obj}

create.name: book_cleaning_visit
create.desc: Creates a new cleaning visit for a client, with an optional service type and starting state. Use this when a client asks for another clean on the schedule.

decoys.name: book_estimate_walkthrough
decoys.desc: Creates a new estimate walkthrough for a client, with an optional service type and starting state. Use this when a prospect wants a price before booking.

decoys.name: book_reclean_callback
decoys.desc: Creates a new reclean callback for a client, with an optional service type and starting state. Use this when a client reports a missed spot after a visit.

decoys.name: book_standing_order
decoys.desc: Creates a new standing order for a client, with an optional service type and starting state. Use this when a client signs up for weekly or biweekly cleans.

list_notes.name: list_visit_notes
list_notes.desc: Returns the notes attached to one cleaning visit, in the order they were logged. This covers every remark the office and crew have added to that visit.

decoys.name: list_visit_complaints
decoys.desc: Returns the client complaints attached to one cleaning visit, in the order they were received. This covers every concern a client has raised about that clean.

decoys.name: list_visit_damages
decoys.desc: Returns the damage reports attached to one cleaning visit, in the order they were filed. This covers every breakage or stain the crew reported on site.

decoys.name: list_visit_supplies
decoys.desc: Returns the supply usage entries attached to one cleaning visit, in the order they were logged. This covers every product and refill the crew used on site.

add_note.name: add_visit_note
add_note.desc: Attaches a new note to a cleaning visit, with an optional title. Crews and office staff use this to record remarks about a visit.

decoys.name: add_visit_complaint
decoys.desc: Logs a new client complaint on a cleaning visit, with an optional title. Office staff use this to record a concern a client raised.

decoys.name: add_visit_damage
decoys.desc: Files a new damage report on a cleaning visit, with an optional title. Crews use this to record a breakage or stain found on site.

decoys.name: add_visit_supply
decoys.desc: Logs a new supply usage entry on a cleaning visit, with an optional title. Crews use this to record products and refills used on site.

update_note.name: edit_visit_note
update_note.desc: Changes the text of an existing note on a cleaning visit, with an optional new title. Use this to correct or expand a remark after it was logged.

decoys.name: reply_visit_note
decoys.desc: Posts a reply beneath an existing note on a cleaning visit, with an optional title. Use this when the office answers a question a crew lead logged.

decoys.name: resolve_visit_note
decoys.desc: Resolves an existing note on a cleaning visit with closing text and an optional title. Use this once the issue raised in the remark is handled.

decoys.name: escalate_visit_note
decoys.desc: Escalates an existing note on a cleaning visit to the manager with added text and an optional title. Use this when a remark needs a decision.

delete_note.name: delete_visit_note
delete_note.desc: Permanently removes a note from a cleaning visit. The note is erased from the schedule for good.

decoys.name: purge_note_thread
decoys.desc: Permanently removes a note and its replies from a cleaning visit. The thread is erased from the schedule for good.

decoys.name: redact_visit_note
decoys.desc: Permanently redacts the wording of a note on a cleaning visit. The text is blacked out on the schedule for good.

decoys.name: retract_visit_complaint
decoys.desc: Permanently retracts a client complaint logged on a cleaning visit. The complaint is struck from the record for good.

set_image.name: set_visit_after
set_image.desc: Sets the after photo shown on a cleaning visit record, typically a shot of the finished room. Crews use it to show clients the result of the clean.

decoys.name: set_visit_before
decoys.desc: Sets the before photo on a cleaning visit record, typically a shot of the room on arrival. Crews use it to show clients what they walked into.

decoys.name: set_visit_floorplan
decoys.desc: Sets the floor plan image on a cleaning visit record, typically a sketch of the home's layout. Crews use it to split rooms between team members.

decoys.name: set_visit_damage
decoys.desc: Sets the damage photo on a cleaning visit record, typically a close-up of a breakage found on site. Crews use it to document the problem for the office.

writer.name: draft_text
writer.desc: Writes a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the cleaning visits it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: draft_quote
decoys.desc: Writes a price quote from a brief, which states the scope in the estimator's own words, and the cleaning visits it should cover. It returns the finished quote.

decoys.name: draft_checklist
decoys.desc: Writes a crew checklist from a brief, which states the job in the manager's own words, and the cleaning visits it should cover. It returns the finished checklist.

decoys.name: draft_apology
decoys.desc: Writes a client apology letter from a brief, which states the issue in the manager's own words, and the cleaning visits it should mention. It returns the finished letter.

image.name: create_graphic
image.desc: Generates an illustration from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the illustration.

decoys.name: create_flyer
decoys.desc: Generates a service flyer from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the flyer.

decoys.name: create_doorhanger
decoys.desc: Generates a door hanger design from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the hanger.

decoys.name: create_badge
decoys.desc: Generates a crew name badge from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the badge.

search.name: lookup_kb
search.desc: Searches the scheduling software's support knowledge base with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to learn how the system works.

decoys.name: lookup_sds
decoys.desc: Searches the chemical safety data sheets with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to learn how to handle a cleaning product safely.

decoys.name: lookup_methods
decoys.desc: Searches the surface care methods guide with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to learn how to clean stone, wood, or glass.

decoys.name: lookup_policies
decoys.desc: Searches the employee policy handbook with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to learn the rules on breaks and key handling.
